d:
Jharkhand ke charchit nisha bhagat mamle men pahli bar jyotsana kerketta midiya ke samne aaeen. unhonne pure mamle ko lekar apni bat rakhi aur kaee aham savalon par khulkar javab diya. aakhir nisha bhagat mamle men jyotsana kerketta ne kya kaha? unhonne apne oopar lage aaropon ko lekar kya saphaee di? dekhie is khas batchit men puri bata.
